text: No significant deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. Earth-observation data shows no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. While minor changes under 0.5 hectares or along edges might have been missed, the analysis confirms no major deforestation took place during this period. The asset had no forest cover in 2020, according to the JRC dataset, and historical losses (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) occurred before the post-2020 baseline. Observations are reliable, with full coverage and annual tracking from 2001 to 2025.
